Имбирь.about: Anti-inflammatory, antiemetic, moderate effect on pain.
Имбирь.caution: Ginger (Zingiber officinale). For nausea in pregnancy: systematic reviews support effectiveness (dose 1 g/day). For postoperative nausea: data available. For glycemic control in type 2 diabetes: moderate improvement. For inflammation/oxidative stress: data available. Safe in doses up to 4 g/day. Caution: anticoagulants (antiplatelet effect).
effects: Nausea (pregnancy, motion sickness, chemo): works (not confirmed)
Имбирь.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved; MA has a moderate effect on pain in osteoarthritis.
Имбирь.how_to_choose: Standardization of 5% gingerols; capsules or fresh root.
mechs: Gingerols: modulation of 5-HT3 and GI motility
Prevention of postoperative nausea and vomiting
Vomiting after surgery: ginger oil RR 0.39; nausea without clear benefit (18 RCT)
T2D: glucose −18.8, HbA1c −0.57%, blood pressure lower; lipids unchanged (10 RCT)
Имбирь.myths: “Cures a cold” - relieves symptoms, does not cure. “Safe with anticoagulants” - risk of bleeding.
